title: Upward Technologies moves GTM to new domain gtm.upwardtech.nl
content_html: On 20 October 2026, the GTM AI go-to-market software built by Upward Technologies was moved to a new address: gtm.upwardtech.nl. The previous address is no longer active. GTM creates drafts for social posts, blog articles, news and outreach for B2B companies from a single workspace. It checks each draft against the rules of each platform. A person approves every draft before it is published.
